I'm having trouble completing the booking. Could you try again?

function.name: book_appointment
function.description: Book an appointment for the identified patient at a specific date and time. Only call this after the patient has been identified and has confirmed the date and time they want.

time.description: The time for the appointment (e.g., '10am', '2:30 PM', '10 o'clock')

serviceType.description: Optional: type of appointment (e.g., 'checkup', 'follow-up', 'new patient'). Defaults to general checkup.

providerName.description: Optional: specific provider the patient wants to see (e.g., 'Dr. Smith')
